rows.en: July, A.D. 1999. The object that fell onto South Ataria Island, a lone Pacific isle,
was a giant space battleship, built with technology far beyond Earth's science.
The battleship brought a technological revolution through OverTechnology,
but it also pointed to an unknown threat from extraterrestrial life.
A.D. 2000. To counter the threat that was sure to come from space,
humanity founded the "U.N. Government," a body above all nations.
However, no small number of factions opposed it,
and they banded together as the Anti-U.N. Forces,
sparking the conflict that would later be called the "Unification Wars."
The war dragged on, finally ending in 2007. Meanwhile, the giant battleship
was under constant repair, to be reborn as a U.N. Forces battleship.
After so many years of war, the threat from space that had started it all
was all but forgotten. Yet the hour of destiny was close at hand...
A.D. 2040. In search of new places to live, humanity
had sent many large-scale colony fleets out into space.
Numerous planets had been discovered and developed into colony worlds,
and an age had come when many a generation called one of them home.
Drawn into the first interstellar war in history 30 years earlier,
humanity had narrowly escaped extinction by wielding the power of "Culture,"
rows.notes: TM had lowercase 'culture'; glossary term is 'Culture' (the Japanese puts it in brackets).

rows.en: made peace with the Zentradi forces, and founded the New U.N. Government.
But the end of the war did not simply mean the arrival of peace.
The work began with postwar reconstruction, then quelling some Zentradi remnants,
rows.notes: TM opened with a bare 'It' with no referent; made it 'The work'.

rows.en: and went as far as bolstering defenses against unknown threats yet to come.
The New U.N. Forces were still absolutely indispensable,
and the buildup of new fighting strength went on as well...
A.D. 2045. The 37th colony fleet, which had left Earth seven years earlier,
built around Macross 7, 7th of the New Macross class, with over a million citizens aboard,
rows.notes: TM moved 'over a million citizens' to the next row; the Japanese has it on this row, so the cut was moved back. 557 px of 560.

rows.en: was traveling through space in search of a new planet to settle.
The fleet's commander, who was also captain of the space carrier Battle 7,
was Maximilian Jenius, the genius pilot of Space War I.
Meanwhile, City 7, Macross 7's living area, had a mayor who even among the Zentradi
rows.notes: TM put 'governed by Mayor Milia' on this row; the Japanese names her and governs on the next row. Re-cut so this row ends at 'even among the Zentradi'.

rows.en: had once been feared as "Milia the Ace": Mayor Milia.
She was also Max's wife, wed to him in wartime in the first interstellar marriage.
Led by these two former aces, the Macross 7 fleet sailed on in peace,
but that a battle with the fearsome Varauta Army lay in wait for them
was something not a single person had foreseen...
A.D. 2059, 49 years after the end of humanity's first interstellar war.
The 25th giant colony fleet to set out, the "Macross Frontier,"
was sailing on toward the center of the galaxy.
The living areas inside the ship recreated the same environment as Earth's,
and over 10 million people went about their peaceful daily lives.
But at the end of that tranquil voyage,
a fierce battle against unknown space creatures lay in wait,
and almost none of the citizens had any idea...
The giant battleship that fell on South Ataria Island in the late 20th century
made humanity aware of extraterrestrial life and the threat it posed, while
it also brought about a technological revolution through OverTechnology.
But the impact the giant battleship had on Earth did not stop there.
To counter those unknown threats,
the "U.N. Government" was founded, a body above all nations, while
factions around the world that rejected the U.N. Government's monopoly
on OverTechnology organized themselves into the "Anti-U.N. Forces."
The "U.N. Forces" and the "Anti-U.N. Forces." Their conflict grew fiercer
and at last sparked the struggle later called the "Unification Wars."
Amid the still-raging Unification Wars, on Mayan Island, a lone southern isle,
readings were picked up that, like the crashed battleship, seemed alien-made,
and the object giving them off was discovered.
Over this mysterious object, which must have been on Earth since antiquity,
the "U.N. Forces" and "Anti-U.N. Forces" began a secret but fierce struggle...
The battleship brought a technological revolution through OverTechnology,
but it also pointed to an unknown threat from extraterrestrial life.
To counter the threat that was sure to come from space,
the U.N. Government then repaired the giant battleship that crashed to Earth
and remade it as the U.N. Forces battleship "Macross."
As fate would have it, the threat from space came on the Macross's launch day.
Having sensed the Macross, an alien battleship appeared near Earth,
and hostilities with it suddenly broke out.
To escape the overwhelming enemy attack, the Macross risked a fold.
With 50,000 citizens aboard, it jumped to the outer solar system, near Uranus.
The Macross began its journey home to Earth,
but it could not shake off the relentless pursuit of the alien enemy.
And today, once again, the aliens launched their attack...
Zola, a planet on the edge of the Milky Way.
Home to the Zolans since ancient times, it was a quiet, utterly ordinary planet
where the Zolans lived easygoing, tranquil lives.
But Zola had one thing that set it apart.
Mysterious giant life-forms that at times appeared nearby: the "Galaxy Whales."
Long revered and feared as gods on Zola, the Galaxy Whales
were in fact thought to be energy beings with a plant-like structure.
